line: Crowley’s Three of Cups: Abundance, Binah in the suit of Water, Mercury in Cancer.

sections.title: What Crowley names
sections.line: The chapter name for the card. The second quotation gives the element of its suit.

quotes.quote: The Three of Cups is called the Lord of Abundance.
“Wands”, attributed to Fire; “Cups”, to Water; “Swords”, to Air;

sections.title: Its place on the Tree and in the zodiac
sections.line: The card refers to Binah in the suit of Water and to the influence of Mercury in Cancer.

quotes.quote: This card refers to Binah in the suit of Water.
The card is referred to the influence of Mercury in Cancer

sections.title: What it figures
sections.line: Crowley reads the card through Binah as the Great Sea, the Moon in one aspect and Saturn in another, and as the spiritual basis of fertility.

quotes.quote: It is the spiritual basis of fertility.
Binah, the Great Sea, is the Moon in one aspect, but Saturn in another;
